title: 'Yoroi Shin Den Samurai Troopers Part 2' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The official website of the Yoroi Shin Den Samurai Troopers television anime revealed additional cast, key visual (pictured), theme songs, and a promotional video for the second part on Monday. Part two is scheduled to premiere on July 7 at 11:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by Kansai TV and BS11.
